text_blocks.snippet: If someone is experiencing an electrical shock, first ensure your own safety by disconnecting the power source or using a non-conductive object to move the person away from the electrical source. Then, assess the person's condition, checking for breathing and pulse, and if necessary, begin CPR. Call emergency services (911) and treat any burns with cool, wet cloths.
